ingredients.name: Whole Wheat Flour
ingredients.uses: Primary structural carbohydrate and nutrient base.

ingredients.name: Soy Lecithin
ingredients.reason: Common plant-derived emulsifier; allergen match for severe soy allergy.
ingredients.disadvantages: Minor allergen alert for sensitized individuals.

ingredients.name: Rosemary Extract
ingredients.uses: Retards oil rancidity without synthetic preservatives.

ingredients.name: Sugar / Invert Syrup
ingredients.reason: Elevated glycemic load. Flagged for Diabetes condition.
ingredients.disadvantages: Excess intake promotes rapid blood glucose spikes and dental decay.

ingredients.name: Palm Olein Oil
ingredients.disadvantages: Saturated fatty acid content can negatively impact serum lipid profiles.

ingredients.name: Iodised Salt
ingredients.reason: Contributes 680mg sodium per 100g. Flagged for Hypertension.
ingredients.disadvantages: Excess sodium intake raises blood pressure.

ingredients.name: Sodium Benzoate (INS 211)
ingredients.reason: Chemical preservative that can trigger histamine response or hyperactivity in sensitive groups.
ingredients.uses: Inhibits molds and yeasts in shelf-stable snacks.
ingredients.disadvantages: May form trace benzene in presence of ascorbic acid; risk flag for sensitive groups.
